modules.name: MATH
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's MATH engine: bytebeat and floatbeat formulas played as an instrument (KEYS) or running on by themselves (THRU), MOTION SYNC to the clock, with its being drawn live

modules.name: KURBEL
modules.description: ESTAMPIE's hurdy-gurdy (GHOULBOX's GURDY: melody string, drones, buzzing trompette, a crank you turn by knob and CV) and its shawm, with medieval temperaments

modules.name: SWARM
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's SWARM: a drone made of the devices around, here virtual ones (no radio): their addresses, makers, bytes and clocks become notes, timbres, FM and rhythm; VOICES, BUSY, MOVE, NEAR, ARRIVE and NEW; THRU or played (KEYS), drawn live

modules.name: LIED
modules.description: A text singer: four lines of lyrics typed on the panel, spoken by eSpeak NG (12 languages, 14 voices) and sung syllable by syllable at the notes of V/OCT, the vowel held while the gate is; choir, vibrato, echo and reverb

modules.name: CANTA
modules.description: MIKU-FM's singing voice: a formant voice that sings Japanese syllables, each gate the next syllable of lyrics typed on the panel; ANIMAL babble, SCAT and VOWELS, five characters, a harmony voice, chorus, delay, reverb, drive; four pixel singers sing along

modules.name: MIAOU
modules.description: MIAOU's toy keyboard: a chip piano, FM bells, a square organ, a plucked banjo and a meow through moving formants, polyphonic; PAW makes every key meow; decay, tone, the meow's length, swoop, breath and kitten, the toy's little speaker; chorus, delay, reverb; a pixel cat that watches the notes

modules.name: SAURUS
modules.description: PALEOTONE's creature calls: a buzzing throat through three formants, sized from a bird to a sauropod; eleven call shapes (ROAR, BARK, HOOT, TRILL, CHIRP ..., KEYS: a creature a key), twenty creatures as presets; SIZE, SWOOP, LEN, GROWL, BRTH, MOUTH, WILD with CV; eight pixel creatures call along

modules.name: FUMI
modules.description: FuMi-1's shigin koto after the Suiko ST-50: the ST-50's measured just tuning, honsuu keys and the in, yo and min'yo scales, a trill that plays in pairs as a hand does, the koto's left-hand ornaments, six FM instruments (kotos, harp, wood blocks)

modules.name: KESSEL
modules.description: A drum machine voice from the open-source LXR firmware's sound engine (Erica Synths, GPL-3.0; not affiliated): three drum voices, snare (with REPEAT its clap), cymbal and hi-hat on GENRA's drum triggers, each lane alone and a mix, 25 kits, kit macros

modules.name: KESSEL FX
modules.description: KESSEL's effect bus as an expander: delay (in divisions of the clock), ping pong, reverb, tube, fold and rat distortion, ring mod, bit crush and DJ filter, one at a time, with a CV on the parameter you pick
